translations.web: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.
translations.bsb: You fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
translations.kjv: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is ➔ not quickened, except it die:
translations.asv: Thou foolish one, that which thou thyself sowest is not quickened except it die:
